message.content: The three in-scope claims are all rebutted by direct runtime evidence, and the underlying analysis is sound: FP16×FP16 products are exactly representable in FP32, so both numerators are exact; only the scale sum and the final division round, leaving ~1.5 ulp relative error — well within the 5e-7 budget. Finiteness held across 6241 exhaustive extreme/subnormal/signed-zero combinations. No new material, testable, in-scope problem has surfaced.
